key_insight: OrthoPilot is a large-language-model clinical AI designed to continuously combine hospital data and external medical knowledge to support evidence-based musculoskeletal care across the full patient journey.
clinical_relevance: The system could help clinicians make more consistent, longitudinal decisions for diagnosis, management, and rehabilitation in musculoskeletal disease, where care often spans multiple visits and departments.
method: Autonomously retrieves real-time imaging, lab, pathology, and order data
Converts evolving patient status into evidence-based decisions from admission through rehabilitation
Validated with a specialist-built benchmark from real-world EHRs and tested in reader, prospective, and randomized deployment studies
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation against 81 orthopaedic physicians, 60 external clinical centres, 1,870 complex cases prospectively, and 8,240 inpatients in an 8-month randomized deployment.
watch_item: Results come from a single system in one specialty area, so generalizability, workflow integration, and safety monitoring remain important before broader adoption.
